title: A consortium comprising Qube Holdings Limited, Global Infrastructure Management, LLC, Canada Pension Plan Investment Board and CIC Capital Corporation - proposed acquisition of Asciano Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Former closing date for interested party submissions of 9 December 2015 delayed pending clarification about the transaction structure.
ACCC received further information from the Consortium, closing date for submissions from interested parties updated to 18 December 2015 and proposed decision date updated to 18 February 2016.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC received further information from the Consortium, proposed decision date updated to 24 March 2016.
Asciano announced a potential acquisition by a consortium including both Qube and Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. ACCC timeline suspended.

Following an announcement by Asciano that it had entered into a new binding agreement with Brookfield, Qube and others, the ACCC discontinued this review. The ACCC commenced a review of the new joint proposal to acquire Asciano on 30 March 2016.
